blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats, skiffs, and jet skis, take guided eco tours, parasail, and join private or group sightseeing and fireworks cruises. Activities include fishing, crabbing, swimming, and viewing events like the White Marlin Open and holiday fireworks. Locations include Chincoteague Island, Ocean City, and Fort Lauderdale with various boat types and customizable private trips.
